conduct: Record epic progress while conducting its tasks.
conduct epic: Record decisions about a whole epic.
conduct epic proceed: Hand off an epic after simulation review.
conduct epic proceed triage: Hand off an epic after triaging simulation gaps.
conduct epic proceed triage handoff: Record accepted simulation gaps and hand off the epic.
conduct epic proceed-triage-handoff: Record accepted simulation gaps and hand off the epic.
conduct epic task: Change one task inside an epic.
conduct epic task update status: Set an epic task's status with notes and syncing.
conduct epic-task: Change one task inside an epic.
conduct epic-task update-status: Set an epic task's status with notes and syncing.
